authors: Vladimir Asriyan, Priit Jeenas, Alberto Martín
official: 官方在线 2026-03-12 · 来源：CEPR 页面
abstract: This paper distinguishes between two types of crises that appear similar but differ fundamentally in their underlying mechanisms: fire-sale crises, where productive firms are forced to sell assets; and demand-freeze crises, where productive firms are unable to purchase assets. While both lead to similar observable outcomes, they have contrasting general equilibrium effects and may call for different policy interventions. Notably, conventional policies can be counterproductive in demand-freeze crises, as they may exacerbate financial constraints and further distort resource allocation. Empirical evidence on the pattern of capital reallocation among U.S. firms suggests that demand-freeze crises are, in fact, more common.
abstract_zh: 本文区分了两种表面上相似但在内在机制上存在根本差异的危机：贱卖危机，即生产性企业被迫出售资产；以及需求冻结危机，即生产性企业无法购买资产。尽管二者导致的可观察结果相似，但它们具有截然不同的一般均衡效应，并可能需要不同的政策干预。值得注意的是，传统政策在需求冻结危机中可能适得其反，因为它们可能加剧金融约束并进一步扭曲资源配置。关于美国企业间资本再配置模式的实证证据表明，需求冻结危机实际上更为常见。

title: Coordinated testing for identification failure and correct model specification

authors: Bertille Antoine, David T. Frazier, Eric M. Renault
official: 官方在线 2026-09-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop a specification test for GMM and Minimum Distance (MD) inference that is: (i) robust to weak identification; (ii) easy to implement and broadly applicable; and (iii) has meaningful power. Our specification test is based on a conditional inference approach: information about the existence of strongly identified directions in the parameter space is exploited to define a data-dependent critical value, which, in turn, increases the power of the resulting specification test by reducing the conservativeness of the corresponding critical value used to carry out the approach. This conditional or coordinated testing approach relies on a novel test of weak identification that is more powerful than existing procedures and is compatible with mixed identification strengths - that is, subvector and/or directions in the parameters space that display different strengths of identification (e.g. weak and non-weak). Furthermore, we show that in both cases, specification testing and testing for weak identification, an empirical measure of identification strength can be used to enhance testing power by eliciting less conservative critical values when appropriate. This new testing approach is illustrated using three applications: discrete choice models with simultaneity and the New Keynesian Philips curve (in a GMM framework), as well as Asset Pricing models with stochastic volatility and leverage (in a MD framework).

title: Exploring Spatial Patterns in Inefficiency Using a Stationary Gaussian Random Field
title_zh: 利用平稳高斯随机场探索低效率的空间模式
title_primary: 利用平稳高斯随机场探索低效率的空间模式
title_secondary: Exploring Spatial Patterns in Inefficiency Using a Stationary Gaussian Random Field
authors: Ioannis Skevas
source: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
official: 官方在线 2026-09-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article presents a semiparametric stochastic frontier model that accounts for unobserved spatial heterogeneity in inefficiency by incorporating a stationary Gaussian random field based on geographic coordinates into the inefficiency scaling function. This approach captures spatial patterns in inefficiency at a fine scale. The proposed model is validated using simulated data and applied, within a Bayesian framework, to a panel dataset of Dutch dairy farms with precise geographic coordinates. For comparison, several alternative specifications are also estimated, excluding the spatial component, the inefficiency covariates, or both. The results confirm the presence of spatial heterogeneity and indicate that spatial dependence in inefficiency persists over relatively long distances. The estimated spatial effects reveal variation across locations, including areas with relatively higher and lower inefficiency. Model comparisons further show that omitting the spatial component and/or the scaling covariates affects the distribution of inefficiency across observations and leads to a worse model fit.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种半参数随机前沿模型，通过将基于地理坐标的平稳高斯随机场纳入低效率尺度函数，以考虑低效率中未观测到的空间异质性。该方法能够在精细尺度上捕捉低效率的空间模式。所提出的模型通过模拟数据进行了验证，并在贝叶斯框架下应用于具有精确地理坐标的荷兰奶牛场面板数据集。为进行比较，还估计了若干替代设定，分别排除空间成分、低效率协变量或两者兼有。结果证实了空间异质性的存在，并表明低效率中的空间依赖在相对较长的距离上持续存在。估计的空间效应揭示了不同地点之间的差异，包括低效率相对较高和较低的区域。模型比较进一步表明，忽略空间成分和/或尺度协变量会影响低效率在各观测之间的分布，并导致模型拟合变差。

title: Never Enough: Dynamic Status Incentives in Organizations
title_zh: 永不知足：组织中的动态地位激励
title_primary: 永不知足：组织中的动态地位激励
title_secondary: Never Enough: Dynamic Status Incentives in Organizations
authors: Leonardo Bursztyn, Ewan Rawcliffe, Hans-Joachim Voth, Desiree Desierto, Mark Koyama
official: 官方在线 2026-02-04 · 来源：CEPR 页面
abstract: We examine performance using data on over 5,000 German air force pilots during World War II. Pilots' effort is hard to monitor; motivation is key to success. Fighter pilot performance increases markedly as they approach eligibility for a medal before falling off upon receipt of the award. The same effort path repeats itself as the pilot nears the next higher-prestige medal. Status-conscious pilots also exert more effort when new medals are introduced. We show that medals serve as substitutes for other forms of status. Medal cachet declines over time as lower-ability pilots receive them, making the introduction of new medals desirable. These results suggest that a tiered, expanding system of status-based incentives can repeatedly leverage worker status concerns to extract effort.
abstract_zh: 我们利用二战期间超过5000名德国空军飞行员的数据来考察其表现。飞行员的努力程度难以监控，而动机则是成功的关键。战斗机飞行员的表现随着他们接近获得勋章的资格而显著提升，但在获得奖项后则有所下滑。当飞行员接近下一个更高声望的勋章时，同样的努力路径会再次出现。注重地位的飞行员在新勋章引入时也会付出更多努力。我们证明，勋章可作为其他形式地位的替代品。随着能力较低的飞行员获得勋章，勋章的魅力随时间递减，这使得引入新勋章变得可取。这些结果表明，一个分层且不断扩展的基于地位的激励体系，能够反复利用工人的地位关切来激发努力。

title: Optimal Public Transportation Networks: Evidence from the World’s Largest Bus Rapid Transit System in Jakarta
title_zh: 最优公共交通网络：来自雅加达全球最大快速公交系统的证据
title_primary: 最优公共交通网络：来自雅加达全球最大快速公交系统的证据
title_secondary: Optimal Public Transportation Networks: Evidence from the World’s Largest Bus Rapid Transit System in Jakarta
authors: Kreindler, Gabriel, Gaduh, Arya, Graff, Tilman, Hanna, Rema, Olken, Benjamin A.
official: 卷期日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Designing public transport networks involves trade-offs between coverage, service frequency, and direct service. We use the expansion of the bus system in Jakarta, Indonesia, to study these trade-offs. We analyze how new direct connections, changes in bus travel time, and wait time reductions affect bus ridership and aggregate flows, and estimate a transit network demand model by matching the route launch events. Commuters in Jakarta are 2-3 times more sensitive to wait time than bus time, and inattentive to long routes. We develop a flexible framework to characterize optimal networks. A less concentrated network would increase ridership and commuter welfare.
abstract_zh: 设计公共交通网络需要在覆盖范围、服务频率与直达服务之间进行权衡。我们以印度尼西亚雅加达公交系统的扩张为例，研究这些权衡关系。通过分析新增直达线路、公交出行时间变化以及等待时间缩短对公交客流量和总体客流的影响，并利用线路开通事件匹配数据估算交通网络需求模型。研究发现：雅加达通勤者对等待时间的敏感度是公交行驶时间的2-3倍，且对长距离线路关注度较低。我们构建了一个灵活的分析框架来刻画最优网络特征，结果表明：降低网络集中度将有助于提升客流量与通勤者福利。

title: Heterogeneous Risk Preferences, Entrepreneurship, and Wealth
title_zh: 异质性风险偏好、创业与财富
title_primary: 异质性风险偏好、创业与财富
title_secondary: Heterogeneous Risk Preferences, Entrepreneurship, and Wealth
authors: Brigitte Hochmuth, Monika Merz, Fabian Prettenthaler
official: 官方在线 2025-05-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies how individual risk attitudes shape occupational choice and wealth accumulation. Using self-reported individual risk preferences from the German Socioeconomic Panel (GSOEP), we estimate that an increase in risk tolerance raises the probability of a worker transitioning to self-employment. We also develop a life-cycle model of occupational choice with Epstein-Zin preferences and heterogeneous risk attitudes to study how risk aversion interacts with entrepreneurial ability and wealth in determining entry into self-employment and its aggregate implications. Counterfactual simulations show that increasing business risk reduces entry but improves selection by entrepreneurial skills. In contrast, Germany’s “1-Euro GmbH” reform of 2008 weakened the role of risk tolerance for entry and increased participation by more risk-averse individuals.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了个人风险态度如何影响职业选择与财富积累。利用德国社会经济面板（GSOEP）中自我报告的个人风险偏好数据，我们估计出风险容忍度的提升会增加工人转向自主创业的概率。同时，我们构建了一个包含Epstein-Zin偏好及异质性风险态度的生命周期职业选择模型，以研究风险厌恶如何与创业能力及财富相互作用，决定进入自主创业的决策及其总体影响。反事实模拟显示，增加商业风险会降低进入率，但能通过创业技能改善选择质量。相比之下，德国2008年的“1欧元有限责任公司”改革削弱了风险容忍度对进入决策的作用，并增加了更风险厌恶个体的参与度。

title: Subjective Expectations of Husbands and Wives and Couples’ Decision-Making Under Uncertainty
title_zh: 丈夫与妻子的主观预期及不确定性下的夫妻决策
title_primary: 丈夫与妻子的主观预期及不确定性下的夫妻决策
title_secondary: Subjective Expectations of Husbands and Wives and Couples’ Decision-Making Under Uncertainty
authors: Aureo de Paula, Christine Valente
official: 官方在线 2026-08-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Many decisions are taken jointly by multiple individuals. When outcomes are uncertain, decision-makers may have different subjective expectations (“beliefs”) about the consequences of different choices. We develop a tractable empirical framework for identifying the relative influence of joint decision-makers’ beliefs without assuming Pareto optimality when beliefs differ. We apply the framework to contraceptive choices in Nigeria, examining the relative weight couples place on wives’ versus husbands’ beliefs. We find that spouses have different subjective expectations, and that the weight placed on each spouse’s beliefs varies across domains. Therefore, the optimal targeting of information interventions to husbands or wives is domain-dependent.
abstract_zh: 许多决策由多人共同作出。当结果不确定时，决策者可能对不同选择的后果持有不同的主观预期（“信念”）。我们开发了一个易于处理的实证框架，用于识别联合决策者信念的相对影响力，无需在信念差异时假设帕累托最优。我们将该框架应用于尼日利亚的避孕选择，考察夫妻对妻子与丈夫信念的相对权重。我们发现配偶双方持有不同的主观预期，且对每位配偶信念的权重在不同领域间有所变化。因此，信息干预措施针对丈夫或妻子的最优定向取决于具体领域。

title: Do proprietary traders provide liquidity?
title_zh: 自营交易者是否提供流动性？
title_primary: 自营交易者是否提供流动性？
title_secondary: Do proprietary traders provide liquidity?
authors: Nittai K. Bergman, Ohad Kadan, Roni Michaely, Pamela C. Moulton
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Whether proprietary traders provide or take liquidity, and how their behavior evolves over the business cycle and across stocks, remains at the center of an ongoing debate. Using a unique dataset from the NYSE, we document that proprietary traders act as net liquidity providers, buying after price declines in a contrarian pattern. Proprietary trader liquidity provision is concentrated in large, liquid, low-volatility stocks and diminishes significantly when intermediary balance sheets are weak. Liquidity provision is stronger when price movements are plausibly not driven by information. Our findings highlight both the role and the limits of proprietary traders in supporting market liquidity across time and market segments.
abstract_zh: 专有交易者究竟是提供流动性还是吸收流动性，以及其行为如何随商业周期和股票种类演变，始终是持续争论的核心议题。利用纽约证券交易所的独特数据集，我们记录到专有交易者作为净流动性提供者，以逆向模式在价格下跌后买入。专有交易者的流动性提供集中于大盘、流动性强、波动性低的股票，并在中介机构资产负债表疲弱时显著减少。当价格变动可能并非由信息驱动时，流动性提供更为强劲。我们的发现凸显了专有交易者在不同时期和市场细分中支持市场流动性的作用及其局限性。

title: Data assetization and audit pricing: evidence from China’s digital economy
title_zh: 数据资产化与审计定价：来自中国数字经济的证据
title_primary: 数据资产化与审计定价：来自中国数字经济的证据
title_secondary: Data assetization and audit pricing: evidence from China’s digital economy
authors: Qing Tan, Xiaolu Huang, Qiqing Huang, Zhaoping Tian
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: As data evolve into a core factor of production in the digital economy, their assetization poses unprecedented challenges to financial reporting and auditing practices. Based on a sample of Chinese A-share listed firms in Shanghai and Shenzhen from 2013 to 2024, this study empirically examines the impact of corporate data assetization on audit pricing and its underlying mechanisms. The results show that data assetization significantly increases audit fees, a finding robust to a series of tests. Mechanism analysis reveals three distinct channels: higher audit resource input, greater difficulty in measuring excess goodwill, and elevated operational risk. Further analysis shows that the upward pressure on audit fees is more pronounced among non-state-owned enterprises, technology-intensive firms, and firms with aggressive earnings management, poor ESG performance, or negative textual tone in annual reports. Additional evidence confirms that data assetization increases auditors’ propensity to issue modified audit opinions. This study extends audit pricing research to data assets by demonstrating how their unique attributes reshape audit risk and resource allocation. It also offers practical implications for corporate governance, auditor expertise, and regulatory standard-setting. KEYWORDS: Data assetization audit fees audit risk audit opinions JEL CLASSIFICATION: M42 O33 G32 G41
abstract_zh: 随着数据演变为数字经济中的核心生产要素，其资产化对财务报告与审计实务构成了前所未有的挑战。本研究以2013年至2024年中国沪深A股上市公司为样本，实证考察了企业数据资产化对审计定价的影响及其内在机制。结果表明，数据资产化显著提高了审计费用，该发现在一系列检验中保持稳健。机制分析揭示了三条不同的传导渠道：审计资源投入增加、超额商誉计量难度加大以及经营风险上升。进一步分析显示，审计费用的上行压力在非国有企业、技术密集型企业以及具有激进盈余管理、ESG表现不佳或年报文本语调负面的企业中更为显著。额外证据证实，数据资产化提高了审计师出具非标准审计意见的倾向。本研究将审计定价研究拓展至数据资产领域，展示了其独特属性如何重塑审计风险与资源配置，同时为企业治理、审计师专业能力及监管标准制定提供了实践启示。关键词：数据资产化；审计费用；审计风险；审计意见 JEL分类：M42 O33 G32 G41

title: An Opening for the Euro
title_zh: 欧元的一个契机
title_primary: 欧元的一个契机
title_secondary: An Opening for the Euro
authors: Barry Eichengreen, Arnaud Mehl, Isabel Vansteenkiste
official: 官方在线 2026-03-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper assesses whether recent global developments have created an opportunity for the euro to expand its international role. Progress in the euro’s internationalization has been mixed — falling short of optimists’ hopes of dethroning the dollar while exceeding skeptics’ predictions of failure. Though the euro has not surpassed the combined global share of its legacy currencies, it has outperformed earlier challengers to the dollar, such as the Deutsche mark and Japanese yen at their peak internationalization in the 1990s, and it remains significantly ahead of the renminbi today. Recent developments in the U.S — concerns over its economic stability, growth prospects, and reliability as a global partner — have intensified scrutiny of the dollar’s safe haven status, potentially creating an opportunity for the euro to gain ground globally. To capitalize on this opening, Europe must strengthen its economic foundations, conclude new trade agreements and enhance its cross-border payment infrastructure with key trading partners, so as to bolster trade invoicing in euro. Fostering pan-European markets for equities, corporate bonds, and securitizations would boost liquidity and scale, enhancing the euro’s appeal as a global financing and investment currency. And establishing a unified euro-denominated safe asset to finance public goods such as defense, while bolstering Europe’s geopolitical credibility, would be critical to achieving these goals.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了近期全球发展是否已为欧元扩大其国际角色创造了机遇。欧元国际化的进展喜忧参半——既未达到乐观者所期望的取代美元地位，也超出了怀疑者对其失败的预测。尽管欧元尚未超越其前身货币的全球合计份额，但它已优于早先对美元的挑战者，如20世纪90年代国际化巅峰时期的德国马克和日元，并且至今仍显著领先于人民币。美国近期的发展——对其经济稳定性、增长前景及作为全球伙伴可靠性的担忧——加剧了对美元避险地位的审视，这可能为欧元在全球范围内扩大影响力创造契机。为抓住这一机遇，欧洲必须夯实经济基础，缔结新的贸易协定，并加强与主要贸易伙伴的跨境支付基础设施，以促进欧元在贸易计价中的使用。培育泛欧洲的股票、公司债券及证券化市场将提升流动性与规模，增强欧元作为全球融资和投资货币的吸引力。此外，建立以欧元计价的统一安全资产，用于资助国防等公共产品，同时增强欧洲的地缘政治信誉，对于实现这些目标至关重要。

title: Does expanding access to high quality technical education induce participation and improve outcomes?
title_zh: 扩大高质量技术教育的可及性是否会促进参与并改善结果？
title_primary: 扩大高质量技术教育的可及性是否会促进参与并改善结果？
title_secondary: Does expanding access to high quality technical education induce participation and improve outcomes?
authors: Yerin Yoon, Shaun M. Dougherty
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Career and Technical Education (CTE) has expanded with the intention to meet a changing economy and broaden pathways to higher education and training. Using longitudinal administrative data from Massachusetts, we generate causal evidence on the impact of high-quality CTE expansion in comprehensive high schools. Leveraging the staggered rollout of these programs, we find that access to a new CTE program induces 5.4 percent of prior non-participants to enroll. On average, while CTE exposure decreases four-year college enrollment, initial earnings one-year post-graduation increase by 8.8 percent among those with in-state employment. However, this early wage premium diminishes by age 23. We find suggestive evidence that these patterns are driven largely by male students and those with access to less college-aligned programs. Conversely, more college-aligned programs induce a 4.8 percent increase in quarters of employment through age 23 while experiencing a more muted decline in four-year college enrollment and completion.

title: Supporting learning in and out of school: Experimental evidence from India
title_zh: 支持校内外的学习：来自印度的实验证据
title_primary: 支持校内外的学习：来自印度的实验证据
title_secondary: Supporting learning in and out of school: Experimental evidence from India
authors: Martina Björkman Nyqvist, Andrea Guariso
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Targeted educational interventions for primary school children in low-income countries have led to substantial improvements in learning, but their impact varies considerably across studies, raising questions about how to sustain their effectiveness in different settings. In this paper, we study a novel primary education program that combines a conventional in-school targeted pedagogical intervention with an out-of-school study group initiative facilitated by the community. To identify the impact of the program and its components, we design a cross-cutting randomized experiment across 200 villages in Assam, India. Our results show that standalone implementation of either component has no significant effect on learning outcomes, but when the components are combined in the full program, they improve children’s test scores in mathematics and language by 0.11 and 0.09 standard deviations, respectively. Our results suggest that integrating in-school targeted instruction with community-based out-of-school activities can enhance program effectiveness by increasing students’ engagement and overall exposure to learning, at relatively low cost.
abstract_zh: 针对低收入国家小学生的定向教育干预措施已显著提升学习成效，但不同研究间效果差异显著，引发关于如何在不同环境中维持其有效性的疑问。本文研究了一项新颖的小学教育项目，该项目将传统的校内定向教学干预与社区推动的校外学习小组活动相结合。为识别该项目及其组成部分的影响，我们在印度阿萨姆邦的200个村庄设计了一项交叉随机实验。结果显示，单独实施任一组成部分对学习成果均无显著影响，但当这些组成部分整合于完整项目中时，分别使儿童数学和语言测试成绩提高了0.11和0.09个标准差。我们的研究结果表明，将校内定向教学与基于社区的校外活动相结合，能通过增加学生参与度和整体学习接触时间，以相对较低的成本提升项目有效性。

title: Affective Polarization, Media Outlets, and Opinion Dynamics
title_zh: 情感极化、媒体渠道与舆论动态
title_primary: 情感极化、媒体渠道与舆论动态

abstract: We study opinion dynamics in a social network consisting of two groups. abstract: Institutional design can shape the political economy of regional development programmes, ultimately affecting their overall efficacy. We test this hypothesis in the context of the Cassa per il Mezzogiorno, a large-scale place-based policy aimed at fostering industrial development in Southern Italy (1950–1984). In 1971, authority over fund allocation was transferred from a centralised committee to newly established regional governments. Combining unique historical data on local administrators with detailed project-level information, we find that, after devolution, municipalities governed by the same party in power at the regional level (aligned) received more funds compared to unaligned ones. In the long run, aligned municipalities received a greater number of smaller projects, predominantly public works. This pattern intensified in municipalities characterised by higher pre-reform corruption, lower industrial capacity, and larger electorates, consistent with a logic of broad electoral coverage rather than developmental targeting. We also show that the positive association between funding and long-term employment growth weakens substantially after the reform, particularly in aligned municipalities. These findings suggest that, in institutionally fragile contexts, devolution can increase exposure to political distortions and undermine the growth-enhancing potential of place-based policies.

abstract: This paper analyzes difference-in-differences designs with a continuous treatment. We show that treatment-on-the-treated-type parameters are identified under a parallel trends assumption analogous to the binary treatment case. However, comparing these parameters across treatments is challenging because parallel trends does not rule out selection bias. We discuss alternative, typically stronger, assumptions that eliminate selection bias. We further show that popular two-way fixed effects estimands admit multiple interpretations, depending on the underlying causal building block, all having important limitations as meaningful summaries of treatment effects. Finally, we introduce alternative estimation procedures that avoid these drawbacks and demonstrate them in an empirical application.

abstract: This paper develops and tests a life-cycle hypothesis of sleep investment. Motivated by evidence from psychology, aging, and sleep research that the consequences of insufficient sleep become increasingly severe with age, we argue that individuals facing stronger productivity incentives should increasingly preserve sleep as they age. We formalize this idea in a simple life-cycle framework in which sleep is a productive activity that competes with work and leisure for time. We test the framework using longitudinal data from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent to Adult Health (Add Health). We focus on adolescent physical attractiveness and college education as two characteristics associated with occupational sorting and long-run productivity incentives. While both characteristics exhibit little association with sleep duration in early adulthood, their relationships with sleep become increasingly positive over the life cycle. Attractive individuals and college graduates experience substantially less negative declines in sleep duration with age and increasingly sleep longer relative to their counterparts in later adulthood. Additional analyses show that these patterns are strongest among workers and are not readily explained by mental health, sleep difficulties, social participation, or reverse causality through sleep affecting later attractiveness. More broadly, the findings suggest that differences in long-run productivity incentives contribute to divergent sleep trajectories over adulthood and support a life-cycle perspective on sleep investment.

abstract: This study examined the effect of the West‐to‐East Electricity Transmission Project in China on agricultural productivity. The project transmits electricity from the resource‐rich west to the consumer‐dense east. Using a Difference‐in‐Differences approach, we found that the project increased county‐level agricultural productivity by about USD 509.5 per person. This increase results from advances in agricultural technological progress and the development of the agricultural industry. Farmer adaptation to improved electricity supply also contributed, such as expanded irrigation, greater land allocation to water‐intensive crops, higher replanting indices, and larger‐scale operations. The project has also raised grain yields and farmers’ disposable incomes, while reducing the agricultural labor force. Only electricity transmission, not natural gas or oil, had a positive and significant effect on agricultural productivity. These results support compelling evidence for investing in large‐scale transregional electricity transmission infrastructure worldwide.

abstract: Abstract Technology is integral to police departments, automating officer tasks, but inherently changing their time allocation. We investigate this by studying ShotSpotter, a technology that automates gunfire detection. Following a detection, officers are dispatched to the scene, thereby reallocating their time. We leverage this shock to officers’ time allocation using the rollout of ShotSpotter across Chicago police districts to study the effects on 911 response. We find consequences for calls unrelated to gunfire—officers are dispatched slower (22%), arrive on-scene later (13%), and the probability of arrest is decreased 9%. abstract: A major claim for the benefits of locational marginal pricing (LMP) in electricity markets has related to increased efficiency in locational investment decisions. However, there has to date been little empirical evidence for this claim. Using a very large dataset of more than 1000 new plant investments in PJM over more than 20 years, we test whether LMPs have shaped investment decisions using quartiles and logistical regression techniques. We show that LMPs and locational capacity prices have been statistic ally significant in relation to where investments in solar and gas-fired generation across PJM, but not for wind generation. We also show that on an intrazonal basis LMP differences appear significant with respect to locational investment decisions for new solar generation within the Dominion zone of PJM. Finally, we note that while LMPs over longer periods of time are difficult to predict as they reflect natural gas prices and other economic variables, LMP basis differentials to a small number of traded hubs are much more predictable, consistent with new generators being able to hedge most price risks at a small number of traded hub prices.

abstract: The sequence-space Jacobian (SSJ) method of Auclert et al. (2021a) has made heterogeneous-agent models far easier to solve, fueling an explosion of applications. abstract: We show that non-fundamental price pressure in sovereign bond markets can raise household borrowing costs even when it lowers benchmark yields. Using recommendations of a Chilean advisory firm as an identified shock to government bonds—the mortgage pricing benchmark—buying-pressure events lower yields yet widen spreads by more than the decline, raising mortgage rates on net. Lenders retain the compression as a wider margin, leaving borrowers worse off. Selling pressure raises yields, with mortgage rates partially tracking at longer horizons. Two placebo exercises confirm the results. Price pressure that compresses benchmark yields can leave household borrowing costs higher, not lower.

abstract: The super manager model developed in Baranchuk et al. (2011) is revisited in this paper. We show that an important condition required for the firm’s optimization problem was overlooked. Once this condition is imposed, the market equilibrium derived in the original paper may fail to exist for certain parameter values. In particular, the existence of interior hierarchical equilibrium is conditional on managerial productivity exceeding organizational costs, and disappears when demand is sufficiently weak, in the sense that no admissible interior super-manager equilibrium exists We derive the corrected equilibrium system and provide numerical illustrations showing that sufficiently weak demand can eliminate any admissible interior super-manager equilibrium. Our results not only clarify the conditions under which the equilibrium of the super manager model is well defined, but also provide economic interpretations when no admissible interior super-manager equilibrium exists.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了Baranchuk等人（2011）提出的超级管理者模型。我们发现，该模型在企业优化问题中所需的一个重要条件被忽视了。一旦施加此条件，原论文中推导出的市场均衡在特定参数值下可能不存在。特别是，内部层级均衡的存在性取决于管理生产率是否超过组织成本，并且当需求足够疲弱时，该均衡会消失，即不存在任何可容许的内部超级管理者均衡。我们推导了修正后的均衡体系，并通过数值示例说明，需求不足够强时，任何可容许的内部超级管理者均衡都可能被消除。我们的结果不仅澄清了超级管理者模型均衡定义明确的条件，还为不存在可容许的内部超级管理者均衡时提供了经济学解释。

abstract: IMF borrowers have demonstrated a very strong track record of timely repayments to the IMF since the 1990s—indeed, no new episodes of protracted overdue financial obligations (OFOs) have occurred since 2001. This represents a marked improvement from the experience of the 1980s and early 1990s. Through quantitative modeling we find that countries’ international reserves coverage of debt service due to the IMF and other creditors, external debt levels, macroeconomic conditions, and broad institutional strength played key roles in distinguishing between past cases with timely repayments and those with protracted arrears. However, we also find that policy reforms and changes in other qualitative factors since the 1990s weakened the relationship between quantitative indicators of repayment capacity and the likelihood of protracted arrears episodes. While stronger macroeconomic and institutional fundamentals of borrowers have contributed to greater timeliness of repayments, a large portion of the improvement remains unexplained by country-specific factors. The timing of this improvement is consistent with implementation of a cooperative strategy on OFOs and other policies that have incentivized cooperation and mitigated “residual” risks on IMF lending relative to the underlying fundamentals of borrowers.
abstract_zh: 自20世纪90年代以来，国际货币基金组织（IMF）借款人在按时还款方面表现出色——事实上，自2001年以来未再出现新的长期逾期债务（OFOs）事件。这与20世纪80年代及90年代初的情况相比有了显著改善。通过定量建模，我们发现，各国对IMF及其他债权人到期债务的国际储备覆盖率、外债水平、宏观经济状况以及广泛的制度实力，是区分过去按时还款案例与长期拖欠案例的关键因素。然而，我们也发现，自20世纪90年代以来的政策改革及其他定性因素的变化，削弱了还款能力的定量指标与长期拖欠事件发生概率之间的关系。尽管借款人更强的宏观经济和制度基础有助于提高还款及时性，但大部分改善仍无法用国家特定因素解释。这一改善的时间点与OFOs合作策略及其他政策的实施相吻合——这些政策激励了合作，并相对于借款人的基本面因素，降低了IMF贷款中的“残余”风险。

title: From Trade War to Green Transition: Optimal Electric Vehicle Tariffs with Revenue-Funded Subsidies

abstract: We study the optimal design of trade and industrial policy when governments pursue environmental objectives alongside traditional national welfare. Motivated by the global transition to electric vehicles (EVs) and growing concerns about competitiveness, resilience, and the environment, we develop a framework in which policymakers choose tariffs and domestic production subsidies to maximize national welfare, defined as the sum of consumer surplus, domestic profits, environmental benefits, and tariff revenue net of subsidies. We combine a theoretical model of differentiated-product oligopoly with a structural demand model estimated using vehicle-level data from 13 countries during 2004-2023 that together account for the vast majority of global EV sales. Our central finding is that the optimal policy combines a moderate tariff on imported EVs with a subsidy to domestic EV production financed through tariff revenue. This policy substantially outperforms both outright protectionism and laissez-faire. Relative to current policies, it preserves consumer access to affordable EVs, accelerates fleet electrification, supports domestic producers, and remains budget-neutral. For the United States, the optimal policy more than doubles EV market share, generates over $45 billion in annual welfare gains, and avoids approximately 95 million tons of lifetime CO2 emissions. A key mechanism underlying these results is the pass-through of tariffs and subsidies to prices, which depends critically on demand curvature, product substitution, and market structure. More broadly, our results suggest that effective industrial policy requires careful attention to market structure and country-specific conditions, balancing consumer, producer, fiscal, and environmental objectives rather than adhering to ideological prescriptions.
abstract_zh: 本文研究政府在追求环境目标与传统国民福利时，贸易与产业政策的最优设计问题。受全球向电动汽车转型以及对竞争力、韧性和环境日益关注的驱动，我们构建了一个分析框架，其中政策制定者通过选择关税和国内生产补贴，最大化国民福利——该福利定义为消费者剩余、国内利润、环境收益以及扣除补贴后的关税收入之和。我们将差异化产品寡头垄断的理论模型与基于2004-2023年13个国家（占全球电动汽车销量绝大部分）车辆级数据估计的结构性需求模型相结合。核心发现是：最优政策组合为对进口电动汽车征收适度关税，同时用关税收入补贴国内电动汽车生产。该政策显著优于纯粹的保护主义和自由放任政策。与现行政策相比，它既能保障消费者获得可负担的电动汽车，加速车队电气化进程，支持国内生产商，又能保持预算中性。对美国而言，最优政策可使电动汽车市场份额翻倍以上，每年产生超过450亿美元的福利收益，并避免约9500万吨全生命周期二氧化碳排放。这些结果的关键机制在于关税和补贴向价格的传导效应，该效应主要取决于需求曲率、产品替代性和市场结构。更广泛而言，我们的研究表明，有效的产业政策需要审慎关注市场结构和国别特定条件，在消费者、生产者、财政和环境目标之间寻求平衡，而非固守意识形态教条。

abstract: 跨境数据流动是数字经济时代企业获取外部信息与提升创新能力的重要渠道,现有研究多聚焦数据直接流动的经济价值,较少研究间接数据流动的影响及作用机制。本文以2007-2016年我国海关进出口、国泰安上市公司研发创新数据库的合并数据为样本,通过构建由贸易通道实现的间接跨境数据流动的测度指标,并区分突破式与渐进式创新后考察了其对企业创新的影响。结果表明：贸易嵌入式的间接跨境数据流动显著促进了企业创新数量、总体创新质量与渐进式创新质量,但对突破式创新质量无显著影响,暗示企业在创新过程中可能存在数据反馈循环陷阱,且该效应通过“信息溢出”与“成本分摊”实现。异质性分析表明,数据反馈循环驱动的创新效应在中小企业、从事数字经济业务以及一般贸易的企业中更为典型。进一步分析发现,跳出数据反馈循环陷阱需要将数据流动与知识流动相结合。本文的贡献在于提出嵌入贸易活动的间接跨境数据流动测度方法和作用机制,为跨境数据治理优化提供参考。

title: Research review on the effectiveness of youth and rangatahi mental health early intervention and secondary prevention approaches

abstract: Adolescence and young adulthood are sensitive periods for the development of mental distress, and timely support can prevent early signs of distress from escalating. This review examines the effectiveness of early intervention and secondary prevention approaches for supporting the mental health and wellbeing of young people and rangatahi aged 12-24 years, with a particular focus on those experiencing low to moderate distress. The review draws on a structured scan of published and grey literature, identifying 20 evaluation papers covering 16 interventions across therapy-based brief interventions, community-based services, e-therapy, digital tools, and family-integrated approaches. Overall, the evidence suggests that many early intervention and secondary prevention supports, including brief and low-intensity approaches, can reduce distress and improve wellbeing, functioning, and coping. Effects were most consistent for broad outcomes such as distress, wellbeing, and functioning, while findings for anxiety and depressive symptoms were more mixed. Accessibility, youth-friendly delivery, sustained engagement, and co-design with young people emerged as important enablers of effectiveness. Culturally appropriate, co-designed, and Indigenous-led approaches also appear important for improving acceptability and engagement for rangatahi Māori. However, the evidence base remains uneven, with a need for stronger evaluation of what works best, for whom, and under what delivery conditions.
abstract_zh: 青春期和成年初期是心理困扰发展的敏感时期，及时的支持可以防止早期困扰症状升级。本综述评估了早期干预和二级预防方法对支持12-24岁青少年及毛利青年心理健康与福祉的有效性，特别关注那些经历轻中度困扰的群体。研究基于对已发表文献和灰色文献的结构化扫描，识别出20篇评估论文，涵盖16项干预措施，涉及基于治疗的简短干预、社区服务、电子治疗、数字工具及家庭整合方法。总体而言，证据表明许多早期干预和二级预防支持措施（包括简短和低强度方法）能够减轻困扰、改善福祉、功能及应对能力。对于困扰、福祉和功能等广泛结局，效果最为一致，而焦虑和抑郁症状的发现则更为复杂。可及性、青年友好型服务提供、持续参与以及与青年共同设计成为有效性的重要促进因素。文化适宜、共同设计及原住民主导的方法对于提高毛利青年的接受度和参与度也显得尤为重要。然而，证据基础仍不均衡，需要更有力的评估来明确何种干预措施最有效、适用于哪些人群以及在何种服务条件下实施。

abstract: Maize varietal turnover is widely promoted across Sub-Saharan Africa to improve crop productivity and increase food security, yet its impact on yields remains poorly understood amid heterogeneous agroecological and socioeconomic conditions. This study quantifies the yield effects of varietal age in Kenya using a three-wave panel survey (2023-2024) of 4,160 smallholder households across Kenya. Using entropy balancing and weighted regression models to isolate the effect of varietal age on maize yield, we find a strong and consistent relationship between varietal age and yield. New varieties yield 147 kg/ha more than old ones in the long rains and 91 kg/ha more in the short rains. Finer age categorization reveals that switching to ultra-new varieties (0-5 years) delivers the highest gains-360 kg/ha over ultra-old varieties (21+ years) in the long rains and 269 kg/ha in the short rains. These findings suggest that slow varietal turnover carries significant opportunity costs in the form of forgone yield gains. While farmers generally perceive new varieties favorably-particularly for yield potential, early maturity and grain quality-concerns around labor intensity and resilience remain, potentially dampening adoption. Providing farmers with clear, locally relevant performance data and opportunities for on-farm experimentation can help shift perceptions and support wider uptake. Policies and programs that expand access to newer, better-performing varieties and strengthen seed quality assurance are essential for translating genetic gains into productivity improvements across Kenya's bimodal maize production systems.
abstract_zh: 玉米品种更替在撒哈拉以南非洲被广泛推广，以提升作物生产力并增强粮食安全，然而在异质性的农业生态和社会经济条件下，其对产量的影响仍知之甚少。本研究利用肯尼亚2023-2024年三轮面板调查数据（涵盖4,160户小农户），量化了品种年龄对产量的影响。通过熵平衡和加权回归模型分离品种年龄对玉米产量的效应，我们发现品种年龄与产量之间存在强烈且一致的关系。在长雨季，新品种较老品种每公顷增产147公斤；在短雨季，每公顷增产91公斤。更精细的年龄分类显示，转向超新品种（0-5年）带来的收益最大——在长雨季，较超老品种（21年以上）每公顷增产360公斤；在短雨季，每公顷增产269公斤。这些发现表明，缓慢的品种更替以牺牲潜在产量收益的形式带来了显著的机会成本。尽管农民普遍对新品种持积极态度——尤其是在产量潜力、早熟性和籽粒品质方面——但对劳动强度及抗逆性的担忧仍然存在，这可能抑制采用率。向农民提供清晰、符合当地实际的性能数据以及田间试验机会，有助于转变观念并促进更广泛的采用。扩大更新、更优品种的可及性并加强种子质量保障的政策和项目，对于将遗传增益转化为肯尼亚双峰玉米生产系统中的生产力提升至关重要。

abstract: This study examines how political uncertainty affects high-skill labor demand among US public firms. Using close gubernatorial elections as an exogenous shock and job postings data, I find that firms increase skilled hiring, mainly through higher R&D investments. Firms shift labor demand to nearby states with stable policies, creating spillover effects. In counties outside uncertain states, higher exposure to treated firms leads to modest job gains for college-educated workers and a slight unemployment decline, with no wage impact. These findings highlight firms as key channels for transmitting political uncertainty across labor markets.

abstract: We study the macroeconomic implications of asymmetric information in capital markets.We build a quantitative capital-accumulation model in which capital is traded in illiquid markets, with sellers having more information about capital quality than buyers.Asymmetric information distorts the terms of trade for sellers of high-quality capital, who list higher prices and are willing to accept lower trading probabilities to signal their type.Led by the model's predictions, we measure the distortions from asymmetric information by studying the relationship between listed prices and trading probabilities in a unique dataset of individual capital units listed for trade.By combining the empirical measurement with the model, we show that information asymmetries can play a quantitatively large role during economic crises when the degree of asymmetric information deteriorates.
abstract_zh: 我们研究资本市场中信息不对称对宏观经济的影响。我们构建了一个定量资本积累模型，其中资本在非流动性市场上交易，卖方对资本质量的了解程度高于买方。信息不对称扭曲了高质量资本卖方的交易条件，他们设定更高的价格，并愿意接受较低的交易概率以传递其类型信号。受模型预测的引导，我们通过研究一个独特的个体资本单位交易挂牌数据集中挂牌价格与交易概率之间的关系，来衡量信息不对称造成的扭曲。将实证测量与模型相结合，我们表明，在经济危机期间，当信息不对称程度恶化时，信息不对称可能发挥数量上显著的作用。

title_zh: 革命性转型：继承制度变迁与生育率下降

authors: Victor Gay, Paula E. Gobbi, Marc Goñi

abstract: We test Le Play's (1875) hypothesis that the French Revolution contributed to France's early fertility decline by imposing equal partition of inheritance among all children, including women. We combine new data on local inheritance rules before the Revolution and individual-level demographic data from historical sources and crowdsourced genealogies. Difference-in-differences and regression-discontinuity estimates show that the inheritance reforms enacted during the Revolution reduced completed fertility by 0.5 children. A key mechanism was the desire to avoid land fragmentation across generations. These reforms closed the fertility gap between regions with different historical inheritance rules and crucially contributed to France's demographic transition.
abstract_zh: 我们检验了勒普莱（1875年）的假说，即法国大革命通过强制实行所有子女（包括女性）平等继承遗产的规定，促进了法国早期生育率的下降。我们将大革命前地方继承规则的新数据与来自历史资料和众包家谱的个人层面人口统计数据相结合。双重差分法和断点回归估计显示，大革命期间实施的继承改革使完成生育率降低了0.5个孩子。一个关键机制是避免土地在代际间分割的愿望。这些改革缩小了历史上不同继承规则地区之间的生育率差距，并对法国的 demographic transition 起到了关键作用。

title: Land tenure security and agroecological transitions: Evidence from a discrete choice experiment in Angola
title_zh: 土地权属保障与农业生态转型：基于安哥拉离散选择实验的证据
title_primary: 土地权属保障与农业生态转型：基于安哥拉离散选择实验的证据
title_secondary: Land tenure security and agroecological transitions: Evidence from a discrete choice experiment in Angola
authors: José do Rosário, Hycenth Tim Ndah, Carlos Marques, Lívia Madureira
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: While land tenure security is recognised as a cornerstone of sustainable land use, understanding of its influence on the adoption of agroecological practices is still limited, particularly in tenure-insecure contexts. This study examines how land tenure security, institutional support, and behavioural factors shape smallholders’ willingness to adopt agroecological innovations. Institutional and behavioural perspectives are integrated within a discrete choice modelling framework to analyse data from a choice experiment conducted with 400 smallholder farmers in Huambo Province, Angola. Willingness-to-accept (WTA) estimates were derived for key attributes, including land tenure security, technical assistance, and financial compensation. A conditional logit model was first employed to establish baseline preferences, followed by a mixed logit specification that relaxes the independence of irrelevant alternatives assumption and captures unobserved preference heterogeneity. The results revealed trade-offs among incentives, with required compensation increasing from 27,250 kwanzas for biopesticide use to 81,749 kwanzas for combined agroecological practices. Secure land tenure emerged as the most influential determinant, reducing WTA by 344%, while behavioural factors, including pro-environmental attitudes and livelihood security perception, moderate farmers’ responses to policy incentives. Overall, the findings indicate that institutional support, particularly tenure security combined with targeted technical assistance, increases adoption and reduces reliance on monetary compensation. These results provide empirical evidence that land governance reforms embedded in supportive institutional frameworks can enhance the cost-effectiveness and scalability of agri-environmental and payments for ecosystem services (PES) programmes. The study offers policy-relevant insights for land-use and agricultural policy design in Sub-Saharan Africa and other regions facing comparable institutional constraints.
abstract_zh: 尽管土地保有权保障被视为可持续土地利用的基石，但其对农业生态实践采纳的影响仍认识有限，尤其是在保有权不稳定的情境下。本研究考察了土地保有权保障、制度支持和行为因素如何塑造小农户采纳农业生态创新的意愿。在离散选择建模框架内整合制度与行为视角，分析在安哥拉万博省对400名小农户进行的选型实验数据。针对关键属性（包括土地保有权保障、技术援助和经济补偿）推导出接受意愿（WTA）估计值。首先采用条件Logit模型建立基准偏好，随后采用混合Logit模型放宽无关选择独立性假设并捕捉未观测到的偏好异质性。结果显示激励之间存在权衡，所需补偿从生物农药使用的27，250宽扎增至综合农业生态实践的81，749宽扎。土地保有权保障成为最具影响力的决定因素，使WTA降低344%，而行为因素（包括亲环境态度和生计安全感知）则调节了农户对政策激励的响应。总体而言，研究结果表明，制度支持，尤其是保有权保障与针对性技术援助相结合，能够提高采纳率并减少对货币补偿的依赖。这些结果提供了实证证据，表明嵌入支持性制度框架中的土地治理改革能够增强农业环境及生态系统服务付费（PES）项目的成本效益和可扩展性。本研究为撒哈拉以南非洲及其他面临类似制度约束地区的土地利用和农业政策设计提供了具有政策相关性的见解。

title: The Dynamics of Verification when Searching for Quality
title_zh: 质量搜寻中的验证动态
title_primary: 质量搜寻中的验证动态
title_secondary: The Dynamics of Verification when Searching for Quality
authors: Zihao Li, Jonathan Libgober
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: An agent samples projects over time, observing quality for each, while a principal can select at most one. The principal values quality, whereas the agent only wants a project chosen. Transfers are unavailable, but the principal can verify quality by paying a cost. We fully characterize the dynamics of verification by determining optimal mechanisms for this problem. With a low verification cost and a long horizon, the optimal mechanism involves a deterministic selection rule that initially discriminates on quality but chooses a project irrespective of its quality at a deadline. Verification occurs with an intermediate probability before the deadline, declining over time. We show how these conclusions change if the verification cost is high or the horizon is short, and under certain forms of imperfect commitment. Our analysis provides guidelines on how dynamics interact with the benefits of verification.
abstract_zh: 代理人随时间推移对项目进行抽样，并观察每个项目的质量，而委托人最多只能选择一个项目。委托人重视项目质量，而代理人只希望项目被选中。虽然无法进行转移支付，但委托人可以通过支付成本来验证质量。我们通过确定该问题的最优机制，全面刻画了验证的动态特征。在验证成本较低且时间跨度较长的情况下，最优机制包含一个确定性选择规则：该规则最初根据质量进行区分，但在截止日期前会忽略质量选择项目。验证行为在截止日期前以中等概率发生，且随时间推移而递减。我们展示了当验证成本较高或时间跨度较短时，以及在特定形式的不完全承诺条件下，这些结论如何发生变化。我们的分析为动态因素如何与验证收益相互作用提供了指导原则。

title: Agenda-setting in local food environment policy: A comparative Multiple Streams Analysis of the City Deal network in the Netherlands
title_zh: 地方食品环境政策中的议程设置：荷兰城市协议网络的比较多源流分析
title_primary: 地方食品环境政策中的议程设置：荷兰城市协议网络的比较多源流分析
title_secondary: Agenda-setting in local food environment policy: A comparative Multiple Streams Analysis of the City Deal network in the Netherlands
authors: Fleur ter Ellen, Mika Grijzenhout, Jesse Vastenhoud, Joost Oude Groeniger, Frank J. van Lenthe 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: • A comparative MSF study of food policy agenda-setting shaped in a policy network. • Framing food environment issues beyond health increased their agenda status. • Food strategies were more likely with consistent views on the role of municipality. • Perceived paternalism fueled political caution in zoning policy agenda-setting. • Being in a policy network helped place and keep food policies on the agenda. Little is known about the processes through which local food environment policies gain a place on municipal policy agendas. This study examines why some municipalities within the Dutch City Deal: Healthy and Sustainable Food Environment succeed in placing food strategies and food environmental zoning policies on the agenda. Guided by Kingdon’s Multiple Streams Framework (MSF) and informed by interviews with 14 policymakers and policy documents from ten municipalities, we conducted a qualitative comparative case study focusing on agenda-setting windows related to food strategies and zoning policies across ten Dutch municipalities. Six municipalities adopted local food strategies, framing obesity, health inequalities, unsustainable food systems, and economic concerns as public policy problems linked to the food environment. Agenda-setting was enabled by committed politicians, alignment with broader health or sustainability agendas, and consistent views on the government’s role. Four municipalities without local food strategies lacked clear framing or leadership and viewed food policy as politically sensitive. Framing fast-food dominance as a threat to health, liveability, and local businesses enabled zoning policy agenda-setting in four municipalities, while legal uncertainty and paternalism concerns constrained it elsewhere. Successful agenda-setting of municipal food policies depended on strategic framing, linking food environments to broader societal goals and local priorities. Institutionalising ambitions in formal visions and structures reduced reliance on individual policy entrepreneurs. Trans-local policy networks such as the City Deal can strengthen local capacity, learning, and political commitment. Limited municipal resources, concerns about paternalism, and limited guidance for zoning policies constrained agenda-setting.
abstract_zh: • 一项基于政策网络的食物政策议程设置的比较MSF研究。 • 将食物环境问题框定超越健康范畴，提升了其议程地位。 • 对市政府角色看法一致时，更可能制定食物战略。 • 感知到的家长式作风加剧了分区政策议程设置中的政治谨慎。 • 身处政策网络有助于将食物政策纳入并保持在议程上。 关于地方食物环境政策如何在市政政策议程上获得一席之地的过程，目前知之甚少。本研究探讨了荷兰“城市协议：健康与可持续食物环境”中，为何一些市政当局能成功将食物战略和食物环境分区政策纳入议程。以金登的多源流框架（MSF）为指导，结合对14位政策制定者的访谈及十个市政当局的政策文件，我们开展了一项定性比较案例研究，聚焦于十个荷兰市政当局中与食物战略和分区政策相关的议程设置窗口。六个市政当局采纳了地方食物战略，将肥胖、健康不平等、不可持续的食物系统及经济关切框定为与食物环境相关的公共政策问题。议程设置得益于有承诺的政治家、与更广泛的健康或可持续议程的契合，以及对政府角色的一致看法。四个未制定地方食物战略的市政当局缺乏明确的框定或领导力，并将食物政策视为政治敏感议题。将快餐主导地位框定为对健康、宜居性和地方商业的威胁，促进了四个市政当局的分区政策议程设置，而在其他地方，法律不确定性和家长式作风的担忧则制约了此进程。市政食物政策的成功议程设置依赖于战略框定，将食物环境与更广泛的社会目标和地方优先事项联系起来。在正式愿景和结构中制度化雄心，减少了对个体政策企业家的依赖。诸如城市协议等跨地方政策网络可以增强地方能力、学习及政治承诺。有限的市政资源、对家长式作风的担忧以及分区政策指导不足，制约了议程设置。

authors: Jordan Claridge, Vincent Delabastita, Spike Gibbs
official: 官方在线 2026-01-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper moves beyond the focus on ‘average’ wage trends in pre‐industrial economies by examining the broad diversity of pay rates and forms of remuneration across occupations and regions in medieval England. We find that whilst some workers enjoyed substantial growth in wage rates after the Black Death, there was a large group who experienced no real increases. We argue that wage inequality in post‐Black Death England reflects the uneven penetration of market forces across occupations and regions, with deep‐rooted customary structures continuing to shape remuneration. Its findings suggest that a more nuanced approach is essential for understanding the complexities and continuities of pre‐industrial labour dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本文超越了前工业化经济中“平均”工资趋势的聚焦，通过考察中世纪英格兰各职业与地区间工资率及报酬形式的广泛多样性。我们发现，尽管部分工人在黑死病后享受了工资率的显著增长，但仍有大量群体未经历实际增长。我们认为，黑死病后英格兰的工资不平等反映了市场力量在职业与地区间的不均衡渗透，根深蒂固的传统结构持续塑造着报酬形式。研究结果表明，采取更为细致的方法对于理解前工业化劳动力动态的复杂性与连续性至关重要。

title: Can science and technology finance enhance urban economic resilience? Evidence from China’s pilot policies
title_zh: 科技金融能否增强城市经济韧性？来自中国试点政策的证据
title_primary: 科技金融能否增强城市经济韧性？来自中国试点政策的证据

authors: Changyu Hu Qicheng Zhao Yugang Yin a School of Economics, Central University of Finance and Economics, Beijing, Chinab School of finance, Southwestern University of Finance and Economics, Chengdu, China
official: 官方在线 2025-07-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The enhancement of urban economic resilience is essential for achieving sustainable development. However, existing research has paid limited attention to the role of science and technology (sci-tech) finance, and its causal impact, underlying mechanisms, and spatial spillover effects remain underexplored. Drawing on panel data from 282 Chinese cities between 2004 and 2021, this paper takes the implementation of the sci-tech finance pilot policy as a quasi-natural experiment to evaluate its impact on urban economic resilience. The empirical results show that the policy significantly enhances economic resilience, and the findings remain robust across a series of robustness checks. Mechanism analysis reveals that the policy promotes economic resilience primarily through four channels: improving financial development efficiency, facilitating industrial upgrading, and strengthening innovation capacity and entrepreneurial activity. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that the policy has a more pronounced effect in eastern and central regions, non-resource-based cities, and cities with higher levels of human capital. Moreover, the spatial spillover analysis demonstrates that the policy not only benefits pilot cities but also contributes to resilience improvements in neighbouring cities. This study provides empirical evidence and policy insights for China and other countries seeking to enhance urban economic resilience through sci-tech finance.
abstract_zh: 城市经济韧性的增强是实现可持续发展的关键。然而，现有研究对科技金融的作用关注不足，其因果效应、内在机制及空间溢出效应尚未得到充分探讨。基于2004年至2021年间中国282个城市的面板数据，本文以科技金融试点政策的实施作为准自然实验，评估其对城市经济韧性的影响。实证结果显示，该政策显著增强了经济韧性，且这一结论在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。机制分析表明，该政策主要通过四条途径促进经济韧性：提升金融发展效率、推动产业升级、增强创新能力及激发创业活力。异质性分析显示，政策效应在东部和中部地区、非资源型城市以及人力资本水平较高的城市中更为显著。此外，空间溢出分析表明，该政策不仅惠及试点城市，还促进了邻近城市韧性的提升。本研究为中国及其他国家通过科技金融增强城市经济韧性提供了实证依据和政策启示。

title: Honey Bees, Almonds, and Colony Mortality: An Economic Simulation of the U.S. Pollination Market

abstract: Motivated by increasing threats to pollinator health and increasing pollination contract fees, we develop a simulation model for the honey bee pollination and honey production market. The model, calibrated using 2015 and 2016 data, incorporates population dynamics, 15 crops, and transportation of managed honey bee colonies across several states. In our model, forage that bees need is particularly scarce, and further increases in almond acreage will have little effect on the fees paid for pollination services. However, increases in bees’ winter mortality will lead to increases in early-season pollination fees and declines in late-season fees. JEL Q11
abstract_zh: 受传粉者健康威胁日益加剧及授粉合同费用不断上升的驱动，我们构建了一个模拟模型，用以分析蜜蜂授粉与蜂蜜生产市场。该模型基于2015年和2016年的数据进行校准，整合了种群动态、15种作物以及跨州管理的蜜蜂蜂群运输情况。在我们的模型中，蜜蜂所需的蜜源植物尤为稀缺，而杏仁种植面积的进一步扩大对授粉服务费用影响甚微。然而，蜜蜂冬季死亡率的上升将导致早季授粉费用增加，而晚季费用则下降。JEL分类号：Q11
